verdict.rationale: The official Salesforce CLI documents `sf org create scratch`, which creates scratch orgs, and `sf apex run test`. DevOps Center is pitched for building, testing and deploying apps and agents securely. Together these point to first-party, separate non-production environments for testing. However, the evidence is mostly bare command names, and nothing explicitly describes sandbox isolation from production data or agent-driven testing against such environments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/scratch-org isolation from production data, a description of the sandbox-refresh/data-seeding workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI-native testing in these environments.
